name: folder-routes
title: Folder Routes
description: Copy or move files quickly with reusable destinations. Manage them in bulk with CSV and JSON, or add folders directly from Finder.
author: jonathancem

preferences.name: conflictBehavior
preferences.title: File Conflicts
preferences.description: Choose what happens when an item with the same name already exists in a destination.

preferences.name: destinationsCsvFile
preferences.title: Destinations CSV
preferences.description: Optional override for ~/Library/Application Support/Folder Routes/destinations.csv. Edit the CSV manually and run Overwrite Destinations from CSV, or use Add/Manage Destinations to keep it updated automatically.

preferences.name: newFinderFoldersCopy
preferences.title: Copy New Finder Folders
preferences.label: Show for Copy
preferences.description: Choose whether folders added from Finder should appear in Copy Selected Files To by default.

preferences.name: newFinderFoldersMove
preferences.title: Move New Finder Folders
preferences.label: Show for Move
preferences.description: Choose whether folders added from Finder should appear in Move Selected Files To by default.

preferences.name: newFinderFoldersPinned
preferences.title: Pin New Finder Folders
preferences.label: Pin by Default
preferences.description: Choose whether folders added from Finder should be pinned by default.

commands.name: copy-selected-files-to
commands.title: Copy Selected Files to
commands.description: Copy the Finder selection to a saved destination folder.

commands.name: move-selected-files-to
commands.title: Move Selected Files to
commands.description: Move the Finder selection to a saved destination folder.

commands.name: manage-destinations
commands.title: Manage Destinations
commands.description: Add, edit, import, export, pin, and remove destination folders.

commands.name: add-selected-finder-folders
commands.title: Add Destinations
commands.description: Add selected Finder folders to the destination library.

commands.name: synchronize-destinations-from-csv
commands.title: Overwrite Destinations from CSV
commands.description: Replace the destination library with the configured CSV.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
